title: Data Processing Overview
summary: This module centralizes all functionalities for preparing raw data (text, images, audio) into model-ready formats. It includes tokenization, image preprocessing, and general multimodal data orchestration.

nodes.label: Raw Input Data
nodes.title: Unprocessed Data Sources
nodes.description: Initial, unprocessed data including text, images, and audio from various user or system inputs, awaiting transformation.

nodes.label: Text & Audio Tokenization
nodes.title: Text and Audio Tokenizer
nodes.description: Converts raw textual and audio inputs into numerical token IDs, handling vocabulary mapping, special tokens, and audio codebook generation for models.

nodes.label: Image Preprocessing
nodes.title: Image Feature Processor
nodes.description: Performs essential image transformations such as resizing, cropping, normalization, and feature extraction, preparing visual data for model consumption.

nodes.label: Multimodal Data Orchestration
nodes.title: Multimodal Data Processor
nodes.description: Coordinates and combines processed data from different modalities (text, image, audio) into a unified, model-ready input format, often for complex tasks.

nodes.label: Model-Ready Data Batch
nodes.title: Prepared Model Input
nodes.description: The final, structured batch of numerical data (e.g., token IDs, pixel values, attention masks) ready for direct ingestion by machine learning models.

nodes.label: Pretrained Models
nodes.title: ML Model Architectures
nodes.description: Represents the various machine learning models that consume the prepared data batches to perform specific tasks like generation, classification, or detection.

groups.label: Data Flow Endpoints
groups.title: Data Flow Endpoints
groups.description: Defines the entry points for raw data, the final processed output, and the ultimate consumers of the prepared information.

groups.label: Core Processing Components
groups.title: Core Data Preparation
groups.description: Encapsulates the primary sub-modules responsible for transforming raw, heterogeneous data into a standardized, model-compatible format.
